title: Empty Decisions shows the screening in flight instead of 'You're all caught up'
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: glyphArrival.ts adds stepArrival(prevWatch, input) -> {arrival, watch, reload}; reload fires exactly once when a watched batch_screen/automation task leaves the in-flight set (finished, failed, canceled, or aged out of the poll window) AND when a watched task's progressDone increases (batch_screen writes each entry's decision before ctx.progress(++done), so decisions land mid-run and the copy 'each decision appears here as soon as it is made' stays honest). A failed poll (loadFailed) keeps the watch and never reloads. DecisionsTab.tsx (+1 line, outside the card's write_set, as the critic directed) passes its queue load() as onArrivalLanded; DecisionsEmptyHandoff calls it on the edge from a useEffect. 'Watch it run' uses useChainNav('tasks') -> buildTabSwitchUrl('tasks'), the same hop the command palette already uses (tabs.ts says tasks is not a nav deep-link target, but the id resolves). The ambient render-site test counts `ambient={ambientFor(` as a site of ARRIVAL_AMBIENT ('pulse'). ArrivalTask is a structural type so _components/glyph never imports the shell; a test pins its in-flight predicate to tasksProviderTypes ACTIVE. Commits: catalogs and doc landed first, each alone under the shared-surface lock; then test (pure module + 11 cases, green on its own) and feat.
notes: Gate exit codes tsc=2, unit=1, perf=1 are all from FOREIGN paths only (detailed below); every gate is clean on this card's files. Acceptance: 11 glyphArrival cases (card cases 1-6, ACTIVE parity, case 9 arriving->idle reload-once, window drop-out reload, per-item progress reload, loadFailed holds the watch) + motionPresets ambient render-site case + i18n:check for the 5 decisions.empty.arriving* keys in 4 locales (cs has one/few/other). Red before: glyphArrival.test.ts failed at import (11) + render-site case (1); catalog case red by absence. Perf: measured on a git-archive of committed HEAD 087ac8cc9: app/page.tsx 1381/8641 KB -> 1382/8648 KB with this card (+1 module glyphArrival.ts, +6.9 KB), inside the 1385/8681 ceiling, so perf-budget.json NOT raised. The shared checkout measures 1389/8715 KB (over) from sibling builders' uncommitted work (readiness.ts, groupEval re-run delta, pipeline subway files) plus the known job-ingest.ts 402/400 line. tsc whole-tree red only on foreign paths: untracked kpi-sim/runs/** copies and a sibling's in-flight app/_lib/readiness*.ts / readinessFindings.test.ts; zero errors on my files. Full test:unit red on 4 foreign files only (readinessFindings.test.ts, health-exposure.test.ts, pipelineBoardRoles.test.ts - all sibling in-flight edits - and python-runner-concurrency.test.ts, an environment process-tree test); the 208 tests under app/_components/glyph + app/features/hiring/decisions pass. Not browser-verified (no dev/build per brief).
